readinessChecks.description: Document approved read-only code scanning, XDR, cloud posture, and repository metadata connectors for the target tenant.
Verify least-privilege managed identities, role assignments, and separation of read-only, draft-only, and approval-gated permissions.
Define durable work-board, evidence, approval, audit, retention, and backup storage for pilot data.
Publish metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and workbook views for work-board health, connector failures, approval latency, and eval status.
Capture target-environment endpoint checks, sample read-only connector calls, and approval workflow smoke tests.
Run a tabletop drill for containment rollback, production change rollback, PR revert, and external communication compensation.
Confirm retention, purge, sensitivity-label handling, and export restrictions for security evidence.

pilotControls: controlled-preview remains certification-ready but not production-enabled
production pilot starts only after every readiness check has completed evidence
all live connectors remain read-only until RBAC review is complete
all outputs remain draft-only until named-human approval workflows are live
pilot scope must define tenants, connector set, owner roles, and rollback contacts
